description: RISK R-B, STATED FIRST BECAUSE THE CLASS NAME INVERTS THE BEHAVIOUR: the prompt-mandated Java class for COTRN02C is TransactionViewController, but this program does not view - it ADDS. Two independent sources say so: app/cbl/COTRN02C.cbl:5 'Function    : Add a new Transaction to TRANSACT file', and README.md:222 '| CT02 | COTRN02 | COTRN02C | Transaction Add |', which is the inverse of the prompt's mapping and the mirror image of parity/COTRN01C, whose program genuinely views. Rule R1 governs the resolution - the name comes from the prompt, the behaviour comes from the source - and practice B4 governs the disclosure, so the divergence is documented here and never silently corrected; the Agent Action Plan escalates it for explicit user confirmation and nothing here guesses which artefact is authoritative about intent, only about behaviour, where the source is the only oracle there is. No case in this folder is downgraded to read-only to match the name: the EXEC CICS WRITE at :713 is pinned at its full 350 bytes by case19 and case20. WHAT THIS CASE PINS: MAIN-PARA's EIBCALEN = 0 guard at app/cbl/COTRN02C.cbl:115-117, the single path that reaches neither a map nor a dataset. No communication area travelled, so the program cannot know who called it: :116 moves 'COSGN00C' into CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM and :117 performs RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN, which at :502-511 finds the target already named, moves WS-TRANID 'CT02' into CDEMO-FROM-TRANID and WS-PGMNAME 'COTRN02C' into CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, moves ZEROS into CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT and transfers with EXEC CICS XCTL. The termination is therefore XCTL and the EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(WS-TRANID) at :156-159 is never reached, which is exactly why the two are not interchangeable. Because MOVE DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN) at :119 is never executed, the area carried forward is this program's own WORKING-STORAGE initial state - blanks for alphanumerics, zeros for PIC 9 items and 'N' for CDEMO-CT02-NEXT-PAGE-FLG, the one field :76 gives a VALUE clause - with only the three fields :505-507 writes set. All 22 fields of the 218-byte area are pinned and none omitted, because the conversation state travels in the payload rather than in a server-side session (rule R6, gate G37) and an unpinned field is a field nobody has checked. WHY NOTHING IS PAINTED AND NOTHING IS SAID: SEND-TRNADD-SCREEN at :516-534 is not performed on this path, so POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at :552-571 never runs and this case asserts no header field: TITLE01O, TITLE02O, TRNNAMEO, PGMNAMEO, CURDATEO and CURTIMEO are values the program does not set here, and inventing them would assert behaviour that is not there. The send list is consequently empty, no cursor field is named because no MOVE -1 is executed, and expectedMessages is empty because the 80-byte WS-MESSAGE and 78-byte ERRMSGO channels are reported only when a screen is sent - the two-byte loss of MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO at :520 is pinned by case02 onwards, where a send exists to lose it. EIBAID is never read here, so no aid is declared: declaring one would suggest the key mattered. The clock is still pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:34 - the single instant all twenty cases in this folder use - so the run is deterministic and reproducible in any timezone (practice B7) even though this path paints no date. DEAD DECLARATIONS PRESERVED, NOT TIDIED (practice B5): WS-ACCTDAT-FILE PIC X(08) VALUE 'ACCTDAT ' is declared at :40 and COPY CVACT01Y at :89, and neither is referenced anywhere in the program's 783 lines - no DATASET operand names WS-ACCTDAT-FILE and no field of ACCOUNT-RECORD is ever moved - so the account master is a dead declaration and its copybook a dead include. The eleven EXEC CICS verbs are RETURN(156), XCTL(508), SEND(522), RETURN(530), RECEIVE(541), READ CXACAIX(578), READ CCXREF(611), STARTBR(644), READPREV(675), ENDBR(704) and WRITE(713): four datasets are named by the program and only two are ever touched. No ACCTDAT input is declared here and no case in this folder may expect an ACCTDAT read or place an ACCTDAT row in an expectation - ParityHarness.seed states that inputs names every dataset the unit under test will read, so seeding a master the program never opens would assert a read that does not exist. The deadness is asserted as the non-event it is: nothing is written anywhere, no account is resolved, and COTRN02CParityTest.DeadDeclarations proves the translation keeps both names as constants and wires no account collaborator at all. THE TWO DATASETS THIS CASE SEEDS, AND WHY: three TRANSACT rows are declared inline because no ASCII fixture ships for that master - it is populated online, not loaded - and each is 350 bytes summed from app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy as 16+2+4+10+100+11+9+50+50+10+16+26+26+20, with the trailing FILLER PIC X(20) present and space-filled (gates G19 and G21). All three stand byte-identical on the final-state channel, which is the positive form of 'this path writes nothing': the backward browse at :644-704 and the WRITE at :713 are never reached, TRANSACT has no REWRITE and no DELETE anywhere in the codebase, so expectedWrites is empty and the master still holds exactly three rows of exactly 350 bytes. Row 0 is additionally pinned across all fourteen CVTRA05Y spans by their verbatim copybook names, with TRAN-AMT stated as its eleven-byte stored image 0000000010A rather than as a quantity, because the gate is byte parity and the zoned sign overpunch that makes it +1.01 is part of the value. CCXREF is seeded from five rows of the cardxref.txt fixture exactly as they ship, 36 bytes wide, and is deliberately NOT pre-padded: app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy declares CARD-XREF-RECORD as 16+9+11+14 = 50 and the fixture omits the trailing FILLER PIC X(14), so the CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 normalisation declared below supplies those fourteen spaces once, at seed time, and is the sole owner of that repair (gate G16, risk R-F). CXACAIX is not seeded as a dataset of its own: app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD defines it as a PATH over the CCXREF base, so the alternate-index read at :578 resolves through the one seeded base cluster and never through a second table (gate G45). Every dataset is addressed by its application.yml binding key rather than by name, so not one fully-qualified mainframe dataset name appears anywhere in this file (gate G46); no tenth fixture is named - the fixture set is closed at the nine derived from app/data/ASCII - and the code page is stated as US-ASCII rather than left to a platform default (practice B8). CASE ALLOCATION, RECONCILED IN THE OPEN (practice B4): this file's authoring brief described case01 as the first-entry screen paint carrying a 218-byte area. That behaviour is already pinned byte for byte by case02 - CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arriving at '0' so NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER at :120 holds, :121 setting the re-enter flag, :122 moving LOW-VALUES to COTRN2AO, :123 moving -1 to ACTIDINL, CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SELECTED blank so the :124 test fails and PROCESS-ENTER-KEY is skipped, then one send of all 21 output items with the cursor on ACTIDINL - and case03 pins the same first entry carrying a selection. Re-encoding it here would have duplicated case02 while deleting the only case that drives the EIBCALEN = 0 guard, which COTRN02CParityTest's own class documentation lists first among the twenty behaviours these cases drive. The guard is therefore kept here and the reconciliation recorded rather than made silently: nothing is renamed, no expectation is weakened, and every binding requirement of the brief holds on this path - CONTROLLER_POJO with no HTTP, no job parameter, empty writes, return code 0, no error text, binding keys only, an unpadded cardxref seed, no CXACAIX table, no tenth fixture, a pinned clock and offset-summed widths. BASELINE PROVENANCE (practice B12): every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED - by structured reading of MAIN-PARA and RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN, cross-checked against the copybook byte layouts (app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy as 4+8+4+8+8+1+1+9+25+25+25+11+1+16+7+7 = 160 bytes and the CDEMO-CT02-INFO extension at :72-80 as 16+16+8+1+1+16 = 58, so the passed area is 218; app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy 350; app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy 50; app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy 300, whose misspelled ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE would be preserved verbatim by any case that pinned it), against the symbolic-map widths of app/cpy-bms/COTRN02.CPY (21 xxxI payload items, ERRMSGO PIC X(78); the xxxL, xxxF and xxxA items are length, flag and attribute metadata and are never payload), and against the real bytes of app/data/ASCII. It was NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution: running the legacy programs is empirically impossible in this environment, which Agent Action Plan section 0.7.6 establishes with eight independently verified blockers - among them a compiler whose indexed-file handler is disabled, the absence of any Language Environment CEE service behind CSUTLDTC, the absence of a CICS emulator, and the absence of the IBM-supplied DFHAID and DFHBMSCA copybooks this program copies at :92-93 - and the change of provenance is escalated as risk R-A rather than absorbed silently. NO USER RULES EXIST: review_rules returns exactly one line, 'No user rules provided', and that line is the whole document, so no rule forces this file into scope and no rule constrains how it is written. The absence is stated explicitly and is not treated as permission to lower the bar: the standard held here is the Agent Action Plan section 0.10.2 enterprise practices, cited by name where they bite - B1 (every literal derived and verified, no placeholder anywhere), B3 (the reference trees app/cbl, app/cpy, app/cpy-bms, app/bms, app/csd and app/data are read-only and were not touched), B4 (both the R-B inversion and the case allocation disclosed), B5 (dead declarations preserved), B7 (a pinned clock), B8 (binding keys, a named code page, explicit literals and no wildcard), B11 (every width summed from a PICTURE clause) and B12 (the provenance statement above). GATES DISCHARGED: G15 (one of exactly twenty cases in parity/COTRN02C), G16 (the cardxref seed stays 36 bytes and is normalised at seed time, never pre-padded), G18 (the diff count must be zero, per module rather than per build), G19 and G21 (350-byte records whose FILLER is present and space-filled, proven by the whole-image expectation as well as by the named spans), G37 (no server-side session state - the whole 218-byte area travels in the payload), G40 (the XCTL at :508-511 resolves to the nextProgram response field 'COSGN00C' at the X(08) width CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM declares), G45 (CXACAIX is an alternate-index finder over the CCXREF base, not a second table), G46 (binding keys, never a dataset-name literal) and G51 (the controller is driven as a plain object - no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container and no HTTP in the path). G38 is satisfied vacuously rather than exercised: the CSSETATY highlight applies only in the REENTER state and this path neither receives a map nor sends one, so no field is coloured; the ENTER and REENTER halves of that pair belong to case02 and to case04 onwards, and this screen highlights in neither state anyway. G30's ordered EVALUATE EIBAID at :133-152 is likewise not reached, because :115 diverts before it; its four named arms and its WHEN OTHER are driven by case04, case05 and case06. DELIBERATELY NOT ASSERTED, because COTRN02C has none of them: G32 (zero GO TO, so no backward jump to restructure), G35 (zero CALL 'CEE3ABD', which is why the return code is 0 and no abend path exists), G39 (no pagination loop) and G43 (no 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC).
